question_text: State what happens to the first __init__ definition if a Python class body later defines another method named __init__.
adaptation_rationale: Retains constructor-definition reasoning while correcting language-specific overloading assumptions.
solution: The later definition replaces the earlier binding for that name; Python does not select between these two definitions by signature.
